worldcombat.skill.lockon.summary: Lock a visible enemy and briefly restrict movement. Only your own subsequent hit spends your lock. Clamp also restricts flying speed; native control refusal makes the reticle open again.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.use.0: Pin a foe before it slips away
worldcombat.skill.lockon.use.1: Drag the target down to buy time for a close follow-up
worldcombat.skill.lockon.use.2: Drag a fast target down for the focus fire
worldcombat.skill.lockon.description.0: The reticle holds one foe for %1$s and drags its movement down for %2$s (Clamp pins its flight too); a physical or special hit of yours spends the lock, and it also fades once the window runs out.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.description.1: Only hitting the locked target spends your lock; an ally’s independent lock remains. Follow-up attacks still need real contact and are not guaranteed to hit.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.description.2: Lock range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s. Single target and needs line of sight.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.hold.on: Clamp: window x1.5 and drag x1.4, the target's movement and flight pinned, but windup lengthens to %1$s and cooldown grows to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.hold.off: Loose lock: only drags the target down, with a shorter window and cooldown, good for holding foes on your line often.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.preference.hold: On, the target is fully pinned in the reticle: window x1.5, drag x1.4, movement and flight pinned to zero, but a longer windup and cooldown; off only drags it down, with a shorter window, drag and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.preference.ai.m: The companion only locks while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller locks at point-blank, larger approaches to lock.
worldcombat.skill.lockon.preference.ai.l: When on, a Hold order does not stop the companion from leaving its post to lock on.
